summary: Comprehensive testing of ERROR707 Studio Yuki AI Assistant - All backend APIs (20/20 tests passed) and frontend UI flows working correctly. Login, Yuki access control, AI chat with tool calling, file upload, GitHub integration, Settings modal, Preview/Terminal tabs all functional.

minor.issue: Initial config file was created with empty API key despite DEEPSEEK_API_KEY being in .env - had to manually update .yuki-config.json

issues: Presets buttons (OpenAI GPT-4, Claude 3, DeepSeek, Groq) appear concatenated without proper spacing

action_items: Fix loadConfig() in yuki.ts to properly read DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from process.env when creating default config
Add spacing between preset buttons in Settings modal
critical_code_review_comments: yuki.ts line 66: Default config creation should use process.env['DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'] but the value may be empty at config creation time - consider lazy loading or re-checking env on each request
Yuki.tsx: Preview iframe uses window.location.origin which creates recursive iframe loading - may cause performance issues
yuki.ts: Tool implementations are comprehensive (13 tools) but exec_shell has minimal security - blocked commands list could be expanded
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded automatically via seedAdminUser() in seed.ts
